summary: A livebearing fish native to northeastern South America and the Caribbean. Aquarium strains come in many colours and tail shapes; males are generally smaller and more colourful than females, and mixed groups reproduce readily.
nativeRange: Northeastern South America and the Caribbean.

features: Males have colourful dorsal and tail fins.
Females are larger and usually less colourful.
The male anal fin is narrow and rod-shaped rather than fan-shaped.

habitat.diet: Algae and small aquatic insects in the wild; aquarium fish accept varied small foods.
